entities.name: Abdullah Ibn Abbas Mosque, Ta'if
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Abd Allah ibn al-Abbas Mosque is a historical mosque located in the city of Taif within the Mecca Province of western Saudi Arabia. The mosque is named after Ibn Abbas, who is buried within the grounds of the mosque.
